scale: Order matched is how closely an order ranked the players to the week's finish: 1.00 is the same order, 0.00 no closer than chance, below 0.00 the order runs backwards.
startersBasis: Starters right counts a standard 12-team lineup, the week's top 12 QBs, 24 RBs, 36 WRs and 12 TEs, and how many of them the order also put there.
method: Each week we set our order before the first kickoff and graded it on its players' points, ADP on the same players.
honest: ADP had more of the week's starters right in the standard lineup, 104 of 168 against our 100.

weekly.scale: Order matched is how closely an order ranked the players to the week's finish: 1.00 is the same order, 0.00 no closer than chance, below 0.00 the order runs backwards.
weekly.startersBasis: Starters right counts a standard 12-team lineup, the week's top 12 QBs, 24 RBs, 36 WRs and 12 TEs, and how many of them the order also put there.
weekly.method: From week 7 we set our rest-of-season order before each week's first kickoff and graded it on the week's points, beside ESPN's projection on the same players.
